evidence: Same byte-pinned FastWAM 45d8e145 source and verified INT8 H3 identity as C58.
Exact fixed mapping is monotonic, unique and endpoint-covering; early and late carrier perturbations both change output.
Real A800 online H3 produces all 30 independent BF16 K/V layers bit-exactly to the retired cache oracle; the oracle cache was then removed.
Trainer reuses the unchanged D0/C58 dense loader, minmax stats and horizon32 pad mask.
C58 and C58b share one trainer and flow loss; carrier-mode is the only branch in model construction and contract.
Canary launcher fixes 8 GPUs, global batch8, AdamW LR1e-4/WD1e-2 and ten steps.
Canary promotion is mechanical only; later effect comparison is preregistered as C58/C58b/D0 with the same balanced-80 and fresh LIBERO protocol.
Layer-wise synthetic backward reaches self-attention output projections in all 30 ActionDiT blocks.

Single-A800 real online H3 plus full30 backward/AdamW passed: all 30 gradients nonzero, peak allocated 41.46 GB, hot step 1.021 s; report SHA256 84a1a541dcfbfb1a083af0cfd5de79b6c1c0b2d5f0ba0279d9a82890a968a1fc.
C58b checkpoint does not exist before the authorized canary.
C58 and D0 identities are frozen; degenerate all-layer49 C58b equals D0 exactly in tests.

Online/cache K/V and action outputs are bit-exact, layer-wise carrier differs from degenerate layer49, and every official ActionDiT block has nonzero gradient in a real optimizer step. This is mechanism, not rollout-effect evidence.
No C58b closed-loop rollout exists.

decision.rationale: Real online H3 parity, memory and all-30 backward passed on one A800. Run the frozen 8-rank DDP sample/seed/checkpoint-restore gate next; no cache generation or rollout-effect claim is authorized by this dossier state.
